summary: Banco Macro S.A. (NYSE: BMA; SEC registrant Macro Bank Inc.) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a CNV relevant-event notice dated November 3, 2026, disclosing open-market repurchases of its own Class B common shares under Section 64 of Argentine Law 26,831. The Bank acquired 45,298 book-entry Class B shares (Ps$1 par, one vote each) at an average Ps$9,840.412 per share, for an aggregate Ps$445,750,985. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory timetable was disclosed. Watch for cumulative buyback disclosure and any tender-offer framework that may follow.
